background.$description: The main surface: the page, a pane, the content area. Text on it: foreground.

$root.$description: The quieter ground behind background: a sidebar, a toolbar, a gutter. Text on it: foreground or muted/foreground.

nested.$description: A ground inside muted, one step deeper. Only on muted, never on background.

foreground.$description: Secondary text: labels, metadata, supporting copy. Reads at 4.5:1 on background and muted.

disabled.$description: The ground of a disabled control or a surface that's switched off. Not a hover.

muted.$description: A 14% tint of primary for a larger area: a banner, a highlighted row. Text on it: primary/text.

$root.$description: The accent as a solid fill, for the main action: push, create, confirm. For small controls such as buttons and badges, not large surfaces. Text on it: primary/foreground.

text.$description: The accent text: reads at 4.5:1 on background, muted and primary/muted.

hover.$description: primary under the pointer: the fill 14% toward foreground.

$root.$description: A lighter accent fill for a quieter control. Text on it: primary/soft/foreground.

muted.$description: A 14% tint of danger for a larger area: a banner, a highlighted row. Text on it: danger/text.

$root.$description: Danger as a solid fill, for destructive actions and errors. For small controls such as buttons and badges, not large surfaces. Text on it: danger/foreground.

text.$description: Danger text: reads at 4.5:1 on background, muted and danger/muted.

hover.$description: danger under the pointer: the fill 14% toward foreground.

$root.$description: A lighter danger fill for a quieter control. Text on it: danger/soft/foreground.

muted.$description: A 14% tint of warning for a larger area: a banner, a highlighted row. Text on it: warning/text.

$root.$description: Warning as a solid fill, for caution: something waits or is at risk. For small controls such as buttons and badges, not large surfaces. Text on it: warning/foreground.

text.$description: Warning text: reads at 4.5:1 on background, muted and warning/muted.

hover.$description: warning under the pointer: the fill 14% toward foreground.

$root.$description: A lighter warning fill for a quieter control. Text on it: warning/soft/foreground.

muted.$description: A 14% tint of success for a larger area: a banner, a highlighted row. Text on it: success/text.

$root.$description: Success as a solid fill, for a good outcome: ready, passed. For small controls such as buttons and badges, not large surfaces. Text on it: success/foreground.

text.$description: Success text: reads at 4.5:1 on background, muted and success/muted.

hover.$description: success under the pointer: the fill 14% toward foreground.

$root.$description: A lighter success fill for a quieter control. Text on it: success/soft/foreground.

muted.$description: A 14% tint of done for a larger area: a banner, a highlighted row. Text on it: done/text.

$root.$description: Done as a solid fill, for finished work: merged branches, integrated commits. For small controls such as buttons and badges, not large surfaces. Text on it: done/foreground.

text.$description: Done text: reads at 4.5:1 on background, muted and done/muted.

hover.$description: done under the pointer: the fill 14% toward foreground.

$root.$description: A lighter done fill for a quieter control. Text on it: done/soft/foreground.

foreground.$description: Primary text and icons on inverse.

$root.$description: The inverse surface: a solid selection, a snackbar, a gray button. Text on it: inverse/foreground.

ghost-hover.$description: The ground under the pointer on a ghost control that sits on inverse, as hover is elsewhere.

primary.$description: The accent on inverse: a solid selection, a snackbar.

danger.$description: Danger on inverse: a solid selection, a snackbar.

warning.$description: Warning on inverse: a solid selection, a snackbar.

success.$description: Success on inverse: a solid selection, a snackbar.

info.$description: Info on inverse: a solid selection, a snackbar.

done.$description: Done on inverse: a solid selection, a snackbar.

foreground.$description: Primary text and icons on background, muted and card.

subtle-foreground.$description: Tertiary text: placeholders, captions, timestamps. 3:1, so not for anything a person has to read to act.

text.$description: Info text: reads at 4.5:1 on background, muted and info/muted.

$root.$description: Info as a solid fill, for neutral information: drafts, reviews. For small controls such as buttons and badges, not large surfaces. Text on it: info/foreground.

hover.$description: info under the pointer: the fill 14% toward foreground.

muted.$description: A 14% tint of info for a larger area: a banner, a highlighted row. Text on it: info/text.

$root.$description: A lighter info fill for a quieter control. Text on it: info/soft/foreground.

hover.$description: A line under the pointer. Only for hover, never a resting border.

$root.$description: The default line: inputs, cards, dividers.

subtle.$description: A faint line: separators between rows and sections.

remote.$description: A commit that's on the remote.

upstream.$description: A commit that's upstream and not yet here.

integrated.$description: A commit that's integrated into the target.

$root.$description: The ground of anything that floats: menus, dropdowns, tooltips, the toolbox. Text on it: popover/foreground.

modification.$description: The mark of a modified file.

addition.$description: The mark of an added file.

deletion.$description: The mark of a deleted file.

rename.$description: The mark of a renamed file.

hover.$description: The ground under the pointer on anything without a fill of its own: a ghost button, a row, a tab.

ring.$description: The focus ring: the keyboard's position, on every control. Drawn 1.5px, solid, outside the control.

input.$description: The translucent outline of an outline button and of controls that borrow it: Select's trigger, SwitchButton, ToggleGroup.

inactive.$description: A selected row while its list doesn't have focus, so the selection stays legible from elsewhere. Text stays foreground.

$root.$description: The selected row in the list that has focus: solid, so the keyboard's place is clear. Text on it: selected/foreground.
A quiet neutral fill for chips, keys and steps: foreground at 8%. Text on it: secondary/foreground.
A card or bordered group sitting on background. Text on it: card/foreground.
A scrollbar's thumb.

hover.$description: A scrollbar's thumb under the pointer.

$root.$description: Added lines' marks and counts in a diff.

muted.$description: The ground of an added line.

emphasis.$description: The changed words inside an added line.

$root.$description: Removed lines' marks and counts in a diff.

muted.$description: The ground of a removed line.

emphasis.$description: The changed words inside a removed line.

comment.$description: Code comments. 4.5:1 on background, muted and a diff's added line, because a comment is often the line that explains a change.

constant.$description: Constants, numbers and booleans in code.

1.$description: Category 1 of 6, for things told apart by colour alone: avatars, repositories, agents. foreground reads on it in both themes.
